2609.05309.title: How Does mHC Use Its Residual Streams? Selective Routing and Near-Identity Mixing
2609.05309.paper_summary: Hyper-Connections and their manifold-constrained variant mHC widen a residual pathway from one stream to n, yet how trained models use this capacity remains unclear: how broadly blocks read and write, how strongly the residual pathway mixes streams, and whether the streams carry distinct representations. We examine these properties in the four-stream residual pathway of DeepSeek-V4-Flash using effective stream counts, cross-stream residual weights, and inter-stream cosine similarity. Read/write routing is concentrated but varies across depth: a typical attention or FFN site effectively uses about two streams, while the dominant stream changes across layers and the representations remain directionally distinct. Residual mixing is modest and occurs primarily in early layers; in layers 22-42, the pathway mostly carries each stream forward separately. Targeted interventions establish the functional significance of these patterns. Replacing the late mixers by identity increases C4 perplexity by only 1.9% and preserves the six-task average score, whereas replacing the early mixers increases perplexity by 41%. Fixing each early mixer to its C4 diagnostic mean increases perplexity by only 0.2% and reduces the average score by 0.25 percentage points, showing that its site-specific structure matters more than its token-wise variation on the evaluated metrics. Likewise, retaining the three largest routing weights per token at every site increases perplexity by at most 2.7% and changes the average score by at most 0.4 points. Thus, the studied model realizes only part of the flexibility afforded by four-stream mHC: individual blocks rarely require all four streams, and late residual mixing provides little measured benefit.
2609.05309.paper_summary_zh: 超連接及其多樣性約束變體 mHC 擴展了從一個流到 n 的殘差路徑，但訓練模型如何利用這一能力仍然不清楚：區塊的讀取和寫入範圍有多廣，殘差路徑如何強烈地混合流，以及這些流是否攜帶不同的表示。我們使用有效流數、跨流殘差權重和流間餘弦相似度來檢查 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的四流殘差路徑中的這些特性。讀取/寫入路由集中但在深度上有所變化：典型的注意力或 FFN 位置有效地使用大約兩個流，而主導流在層之間變化，表示保持方向上明顯不同。殘差混合是適度的，主要發生在早期層；在第 22 到 42 層中，該路徑大多分別向前傳遞每個流。針對性干預確立了這些模式的功能意義。將後期混合器替換為身份僅使 C4 困惑度增加 1.9%，並保持六任務的平均分數，而將早期混合器替換則使困惑度增加 41%。將每個早期混合器固定在其 C4 診斷均值上僅使困惑度增加 0.2%，並將平均分數降低 0.25 個百分點，顯示其特定位置的結構比在評估指標上的逐詞變化更為重要。同樣，在每個位置保留每個標記的三個最大路由權重最多使困惑度增加 2.7%，並使平均分數變化最多 0.4 分。因此，所研究的模型僅實現了四流 mHC 所提供的部分靈活性：單個區塊很少需要所有四個流，而後期殘差混合提供的測量效益很小。
